snippet.title: (PS1) Crisis Beat - Full Game Walkthrough (CO-OP)
snippet.description: Crisis Beat is a 1998 video game for the Sony PlayStation, developed by Japanese studio Soft Machine and published by Bandai. It is a beat-em-up style game. The story is set on a cruise liner where terrorists hijack the ship and the player must pick a pair of characters to fight back.
